nom: Banila Co Overnight Firming Retinol Sleeping Mask

avis.texte: I have been using this for about 2ish weeks now and love it! I use this every other night while using the cica sleeping mask also from Banila Co. I feel like the Retinol in this is super beginner friendly and actually very hydrating. I've noticed my skin is softer and smoother in the mornings and slowly I'm losing my dark acne scars. I am sensitive and acne prone and this is a big yes from me!
